title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Sharp Practice
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Opposing counsel emails a paralegal stating they intend to file a Defence, but due to a calendaring error, they miss the deadline by one day. The paralegal immediately marches to the courthouse to note the defendant in default without informing opposing counsel. This is an example of:
options: Sharp practice, which is prohibited under the duty of civility.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 (Civility). A paralegal must avoid "sharp practice"—taking advantage of slips, irregularities, or mistakes on the part of other licensees not going to the merits of the case. Noting an opponent in default when they explicitly stated an intention to defend, without giving notice, is classic sharp practice.
